preserves: cfg_e restart 999/1000 on seeds 277000-277999 stays. This is a different law: the later-cycle yaw integral is reset once at the cycle edge. Development seeds 279000-279047 and the replay of 277378 are not in the qualification.
restart_pass: Upright. Speed 6.2-7.6 s below 0.03 m/s. Speed 9.5-11.5 s above 0.08 m/s. |final yaw| <= 15 deg. Second rise waits for the next double-support edge at or after 8 s. That later cycle resets the yaw integral once and uses a 0.04 rad trim cap. The first walk keeps 0.02 rad and does not reset.
straight_pass: Upright, |final yaw| <= 15 deg, progress >= 0.08 m/s. Regression only.
not_in_this_prereg: 15 deg/s 90 deg commands remain outside the measured 8-10 deg/s body rate. The 8 deg/s screen is diagnostic and is not a qualification. Slalom seed 271181 still falls. Fast-stride seed 276309 still finishes at +26 deg. Those commands are not re-sampled here.

bounds_if_nominal_perfect.note: Only if restart is 1000/1000. A 100-seed Wilson lower near 96% is not a 99.5% mass claim.

criterion: The n=1000 restart block needs its own Wilson 95% lower bound >= 0.995. Not pooled with cfg_e or any other command, direction, or head.
